title: Moon-based geometric calibration and airglow projection for long-exposure all-sky airglow images without usable stellar references
description: Self-contained MATLAB code package accompanying the manuscript on moon-based geometric calibration of a 180-degree all-sky airglow imager and 250 km airglow projection for long-exposure (180 s) archival data without usable stellar references. Contains the calibration pipeline, geometric projection, plasma-bubble detection, synthetic positive controls, and a verification script that reproduces every numerical value printed in the paper from the bundled calibration solutions (no raw frames required).
notes: Raw observations are not bundled with this package; see data/README.md and data/raw/README.md for the expected layout. The Fuke (Danzhou, Hainan) station all-sky airglow imager raw data are openly available from the National Space Science Data Center (DOI 10.12176/01.05.010).
